en: The postcard features a black and white photograph of a busy industrial port, with ships docked alongside a quay equipped with large cranes for loading and unloading cargo. The foreground shows a ship named 'Bolivia' with the home port 'København' (Copenhagen), and the docks are bustling with freight-handling equipment and warehouses. The text below the image is in Swedish and describes the location and significance of the free port (frihamn) in Gothenburg.
